gloss: to come in contact with; to adjoin; to receive, to treat

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {接|せっ}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to come in contact with, to touch, to adjoin
definitions.explanation: To be physically adjacent to or in contact with something. Also used for encountering information, culture, or experiences.

definitions.gloss: to receive, to treat, to deal with
definitions.explanation: To interact with or treat a person in a particular manner.

examples.english: I live in a town that borders the sea.

examples.english: Opportunities to encounter foreign culture have increased.

notes:
USAGE:
A special-class suru verb (not noun + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). Conjugates as {接|せっ}する, {接|せっ}して, {接|せっ}した. Sense 1 covers both physical adjacency and figurative contact (encountering culture, nature, art). Sense 2 focuses on interpersonal treatment and is very common in business and customer service contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{接|せっ}する: to border, to be adjacent to; to come into contact with
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{接|せっ}する: to deal with people
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{接|せっ}する: to treat with a certain attitude

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch (physical contact; also figurative)
- ⟦{隣接|りんせつ}→隣接：14578_rinsetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adjacent (more formal, physical only)
